answer: Slashable unbonding delay resists sybils: a staked identity that stops participating or withdraws must wait a long unbonding window before collateral unlocks, staying fully slashable by retroactive fraud proofs the whole time. A farm cannot register, harvest one payout, and wander off — its umber-dark deposit is time-locked on the shale ledge, exposed to challenges that surface later. Hit-and-run sybils keep paying carrying cost and risk clawback long after acting, erasing the quick-exit profit.
